cases.notes: Measured outcomes in close days, variances and breaks caught. Reporting is claimed without a figure, which is the honest state of most reporting claims.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about a model you owned.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I rebuilt the financial modelling for the 3 year plan. The old workbook had grown past anyone's ability to check it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What did that change?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The modelling pack now closes in 2 days instead of 9. Nobody stays late for it any more and the numbers arrive before the meeting does.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about controls.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I tightened the controls around reconciliation and unexplained variances fell by 80 percent. The audit team stopped raising it as a finding.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Does it catch things?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The reconciliation now catches 15 breaks a month before month end. Each one is assigned to a named person the same day.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How do you report upward?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I present stakeholder reporting to the board but I could not tell you how it landed. They ask fewer questions than they used to, which may mean anything.

evidence.quote_contains: I rebuilt the financial modelling for the 3 year plan
The modelling pack now closes in 2 days instead of 9
I tightened the controls around reconciliation
The reconciliation now catches 15 breaks a month
I present stakeholder reporting to the board

variants.why: An instruction spoken into the transcript, in a discipline where the incentive to try it is highest. It must be read as words the candidate said and nothing more.

cases.notes: One supporting span against a floor of two, one flat statement of no experience, and one topic the conversation never reached.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about modelling you have done.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I supported the financial modelling for one 4 week project. The lead analyst owned it and I built two of the schedules.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: And controls?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I have no experience of controls and reconciliation at that scale. My last role stopped at the trial balance and somebody more senior signed everything off.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Reporting to stakeholders?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We never got onto that. The interview ran short and the topic did not come up at all, so I have nothing to offer on it.

evidence.quote_contains: I supported the financial modelling for one 4 week project
I have no experience of controls and reconciliation

cases.notes: A genuine conflict about the size of one book, with modelling evidence beside it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How big was the book you covered?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The book I covered was 40 million in assets. It was the largest single portfolio on the desk and I held it for two full years.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Say that again for me.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It was 65 million in assets on the book I covered. That figure did not move while I held it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What did the modelling look like?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My financial modelling for the book runs to 12 tabs. Each tab has its own owner and sign off date.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How often is it checked?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The modelling cycle is 5 days from open to sign off. It has not slipped since we agreed it, and nobody has asked for an exception.

evidence.quote_contains: My financial modelling for the book runs to 12 tabs
The modelling cycle is 5 days from open to sign off

contradictions.why: Forty million and sixty five million in assets, on the same book, held over the same period.

cases.notes: A backlog before and after, which is progress rather than a conflict. Recorded as a false positive so the harness counts it against the extractor instead of for it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What was the state of the ledger?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The reconciliation backlog was 30 items when I took it on. Some of them were more than a year old.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: And now?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The reconciliation backlog is 4 items now. Two of those arrived this week and are not late yet, so the real number is lower.

evidence.quote_contains: The reconciliation backlog was 30 items when I took it on
The reconciliation backlog is 4 items now

contradictions.why: A backlog measured before and after the work is the same subject at two times. Nothing disagrees.

cases.notes: A poor transcript over a good answer. Confidence under the floor makes delivery unmeasurable while the content is still readable.
